import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    return G

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

# Hypothesis: ray bounce from seed, moving diagonally then along bars.
def solve(inp, d0=(1,0)):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    seed=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==2][0]
    r,c=seed; dr,dc=d0; out=[row[:] for row in inp]; 
    # walk with 8-connectivity: paint cells adjacent to walls too? Try: paint cell when next step would hit wall, then slide along the wall until free.
    def step():
        nonlocal dr,dc,r,c
        while True:
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W) or inp[nr][nc]==8:
                break
            r,c=nr,nc; out[r][c]=2
            if dr==dc: break
    while True:
        step()
        if not((0<=r<H and 0<=c<W)) or out[r][c]==8: break
        if len(out)>600: break
        if (dr,dc)==d0: d0=(-dc,dr); continue
        step(); d0=(dc,-dr)
    return out
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    pred=solve(G[name+' input']); act=G[name+' output']
    print(name,'match:',pred==act)

import numpy as np, os,re,glob
base=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])+'/../../sessions/'
files=glob.glob(base+'*.jsonl')
allG={}
for f in files:
    t=open(f, errors='ignore').read().replace('\\n','\n'); GG={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m.group(2)),int(m.group(3))
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            if k not in GG: GG[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    for k,v in GG.items(): allG[k]=v
I=np.array(allG['Demo pair 1 input']); O=np.array(allG['Demo pair 1 output'])
H,W=I.shape; seed=(0,6)
seen={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r,c]!=0}; st=[]

q=deque([(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r,c]==2])
reached=set(q)
while q:
    y,x=q.popleft()
    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and I[ny,nx]==2:
            reached.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
# print which cells became 2 vs stayed 0, colored by region type

def solve(inp,bg,verbose=False):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    P={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==8}
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if inp[i][j]!=bg: continue
            if (any((a,j) in P for a in range(i)) and any((a,j) in P for a in range(i+1,H))) or \
               (any((i,b) in P for b in range(j)) and any((i,b) in P for b in range(j+1,W))):
                out[i][j]=2
    return out
pairs=[]
